amendments_incorporated.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Amendment Rules, 2021
amendments_incorporated.key_impact: Mandatory Unit Sale Price (USP) under Rule 6(11), omission of Rule 5 standard sizes, multi-pack promotional rule 4(2)

amendments_incorporated.title: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) (Second Amendment) Rules, 2022
amendments_incorporated.key_impact: QR Code declaration allowances for electronic products for address, generic name, dimensions, while keeping phone and email on physical package

weight_threshold_min.rule: Packages <= 10g or 10ml are exempt from these rules (except between 10g-20g which still require MRP and Net Qty)

weight_threshold_max.rule: Packages > 25kg or 25L are exempt (Rule 3), except cement and fertilizer bags up to 50kg

special_exemptions: Fast food packed by restaurant or hotel
Drugs covered under Drugs (Price Control) Order, 1995
Agricultural farm produce in packages above 50kg
Packaged commodities meant for industrial or institutional consumers (direct consumption)

declarations.name: Name and Complete Address of Manufacturer / Packer / Importer
declarations.validation_logic: Must contain company name and postal address with pin code. Shorter address permissible only if registered under Rule 28.
declarations.qr_code_exception_note: For electronic products, manufacturer name must remain on package, address can be via QR code.

declarations.name: Country of Origin
declarations.validation_logic: Mandatory for all imported goods; must declare 'Country of Origin: [Country]' or 'Made in [Country]'.

declarations.name: Common or Generic Name of Commodity
declarations.validation_logic: Must state the generic/common name. If multi-product package, must state each product name with number or quantity.

declarations.name: Net Quantity in Standard SI Units
declarations.validation_logic: Standard SI symbols only. Quantity cannot be qualified with deceptive/approximating words (Rule 12(6)).

declarations.name: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
declarations.validation_logic: Month and year must be explicitly stated. Date of manufacture/packing cannot be a future date compared to inspection date.

declarations.name: Maximum Retail Price (MRP)
required_syntax_patterns: MRP Rs. XX (incl. of all taxes)
Maximum Retail Price Rs. XX (inclusive of all taxes)
MRP Rs. XX.XX incl. of all taxes
declarations.validation_logic: Must be in Indian currency. Must explicitly state 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes'. Rounding off rules apply.

declarations.name: Unit Sale Price (USP)

mandatory_conditions.by_number: Rs. __ per number or per piece / per unit

declarations.validation_logic: Mandatory across all applicable packages. Printed USP must equal MRP divided by Net Quantity within tolerance.

declarations.name: Consumer Care / Grievance Redressal Details
declarations.validation_logic: Must declare name/designation of grievance contact, complete postal address, telephone/helpline number, and email address. For electronics with QR code, telephone and email MUST still be on the physical package itself.

declarations.name: Dimensions / Size of Commodity
declarations.applicability: Mandatory for textiles, bedsheets, hosiery, cables, containers, bags sold by dimensions or size.

font_size_and_pdp_schedule_II.description: Rule 7 & Schedule II - Minimum height of numerals and letters based on Net Quantity and Area of Principal Display Panel

clear_surrounding_space_rule_8.top_and_bottom_clearance: Space equal to at least the height of the numeral declaration
clear_surrounding_space_rule_8.left_and_right_clearance: Space equal to at least twice the height of the numeral declaration

contrast_and_legibility_rule_9.contrast_requirement: Printed, painted or inscribed in a color that contrasts conspicuously with the background of the label
contrast_and_legibility_rule_9.prominence: Must be distinct, prominent, and legible (cannot require reading through liquids or transparent packaging)

language_rule_9_4.additional_languages: Any other language is permitted as an additional translation

stickering_and_alteration_rule_6_3_and_1.prohibition_of_stickers: Affixing individual stickers to alter or make statutory declarations is strictly prohibited (Rule 6(3))
stickering_and_alteration_rule_6_3_and_1.sole_exception: A sticker is allowed ONLY for reducing the MRP (providing a lower revised price) without obscuring the manufacturer's original declaration
stickering_and_alteration_rule_6_3_and_1.obliteration_penalty: Smudging, obscuring, or altering the retail sale price is punishable under Rule 18(5) and Section 36
